MDS will no longer support the autocomplete component.

`mds-popover` and it's set of trigger and content components are the drop in replacement.

props.name: items

The list of items to show in the breadcrumb.

Use {label: string, value: string}[] by passing an array of objects that have a value and label property. The "value" property must be unique for each item. You can optionally override the properties we use for label and value on your objects by setting the valueproperty and labelproperty props.

The selected items of the autocomplete. Pass an array of objects or string representation of an array of objects for multiselect. Pass a single item or string of the value/object for single select.

Use {}[] by passing an array of objects, {} for a single select, or a string representing the value of the selected item.

events.docs:
Event emitted when the selected values of the autocomplete have changed.
With multiselect, emits either the list of selected items, selected values if using prop `usestringasvalue` or `selectbyvalue`, or an empty array if none selected
With single select, emits either the selected item, selected value if using prop `usestringasvalue` or `selectbyvalue`, or null if nothing selected
